description: Clean-room method-only fixture for ADK harness/loop engineering contracts. It is not an executable benchmark and must not start external runtimes.

sandbox_terminal_harness.task_instruction: Create a deterministic text artifact and verify its content without network access.
sandbox_terminal_harness.oracle_solution: build/harness-loop/result.txt contains exactly one expected marker line.

stdout_stderr_capture.redaction: no secrets expected; still redact tokens before archive

sandbox_terminal_harness.cleanup_policy: remove build/harness-loop unless evidence retention is requested

reproducible_execution_pipeline.cache_policy: no cache; read current tracked files

trace_export_policy.redaction: store command names and status only

reproducible_execution_pipeline.archive_policy: retain report path and command status; do not store raw secrets
reproducible_execution_pipeline.rollback_path: remove fixture path and manifest fixture reference

artifact_lineage_evidence.quality_check: required contract fields are present and runtime_enabled is false
artifact_lineage_evidence.retention_policy: tracked fixture retained with manifest contract
